# Inspector E2E — Test Backlog

> **Scope:** Inspector UI/features only. The finance demo agent (`e2e/agent/`) exists to produce
> diagnostic conversation events — we do not aim to regression-test agent flows.
>
> **Out of scope:** Embedded mode (`isEmbedded`), conversation replay, finance demo flows
> (transfers, cards, help, etc.).

For conventions when implementing items here, see [authoring-tests.md](authoring-tests.md) and
[../CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md).

---

## Already well covered

| Area | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| Chat shell | Inspect toggle, restart, send (Enter + button), session banner, loading dots |
| Conversation log | Flow/action/slot/utter events; balance-check progression |
| Event details | Flow, action, slot, bot/user message panels; close/re-click; keyboard Enter; accordion |
| Canvas | Zoom/fit, live highlighting, no-active-flow placeholder, `/data` 500 error |
| View switcher | Active Flow, History, Memory |
| All layout | 3-panel layout, side-panel event details, 1536px breakpoint |
| Downloads | E2E YAML, tracker logs JSON, disabled-after-restart, content checks |
| Voice UI | Send/voice toggle, start/stop call, timer, input disabled during call |
| Diagnostics | Agent/MCP/error triggers, flow interruption, rich messages (modal, image, memory slots) |
| A11y | Event details close via keyboard Enter |

---

## P0 — Deferred inspector triggers

**Requires agent work first** — new magic utterances + flows in `e2e/agent/` before Playwright.

| ID | Test case | Spec | Flow | Agent prerequisite |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P0-1 | Agent timeout shows timeout event, error dot, and error details | `tests/agent-events.test.ts` | `flows/agent.flow.ts` → `triggerAgentTimeoutAndAssertEvents`, `openAgentTimeoutDetailsAndAssert` | Add `inspector test agent timeout` to `inspector_traces.yml`; document in `agent/docs/E2E_TRIGGERS.md` |
| P0-2 | Flow cancel shows cancelled event in log and timeline status | `tests/flow-lifecycle.test.ts` | `flows/flow-lifecycle.flow.ts` → `triggerFlowCancelAndAssertEvents`, `assertCancelledFlowInTimeline` | Add cancel trigger flow (user aborts mid-collect); align with `flow_cancelled` in download util |

**UI actions to extend:** `conversation-log.actions.ts`, `event-details.actions.ts`, `history-timeline.actions.ts`.

Documented as deferred in `agent/docs/E2E_TRIGGERS.md`: agent timeout, flow-cancel flows.

## P1 — Extend existing diagnostic specs (log-only → details panel)

No new agent work — reuse triggers already in the suite.

| ID | Test case | Spec | Flow change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P1-1 | Custom tool success opens MCP tool details (arguments + result) | `tests/agent-events.test.ts` | `agent.flow.ts` → `openCustomToolEventDetailsAndAssert` |
| P1-2 | Context7 lookup opens MCP tool details | `tests/mcp-events.test.ts` | `mcp.flow.ts` → `openContext7McpEventDetailsAndAssert` |
| P1-3 | DeepWiki MCP opens ask_question tool details | `tests/mcp-events.test.ts` | `mcp.flow.ts` → `openDeepWikiMcpEventDetailsAndAssert` |
| P1-4 | Flow interrupted event opens flow details panel | `tests/flow-lifecycle.test.ts` | `flow-lifecycle.flow.ts` → `openFlowInterruptedDetailsAndAssert` |
| P1-5 | Sub-agent interrupted event opens sub-agent details | `tests/flow-lifecycle.test.ts` | `flow-lifecycle.flow.ts` → `openSubAgentInterruptedDetailsAndAssert` |

**Pattern:** Chain trigger (already covered) + open details, mirroring `mcp-events.test.ts` direct MCP
success case.

## P2 — All layout gaps

| ID | Test case | Spec | Flow / inline |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P2-1 | All layout side panel shows memory section with system slots when no event selected | `tests/all-view.test.ts` | `all-view.flow.ts` → `assertMemoryPanelInSidePanel` |
| P2-2 | Slot, bot message, and MCP event details open in side panel without hiding canvas | `tests/all-view.test.ts` | `all-view.flow.ts` → `openSlotDetailsInAllLayoutAndAssert`, etc. |
| P2-3 | Closing details in All layout restores memory section (not only history) | `tests/all-view.test.ts` | Extend `closeEventDetailsAndAssertSidePanelRestored` |

**Note:** `memory-panel.actions.ts` locators currently target `inspector-canvas`. All-layout memory
lives under `inspector-side-panel` — extend locators or add a `panel` scope parameter.

## Suggested implementation order

1. **P3** — modal close, input disabled, Escape (~1 PR, no agent changes)
2. **P1** — details panels for existing triggers (~1 PR)
3. **P2** — All layout memory + side-panel event types (~1 PR)
4. **P4-1, P4-3** — empty states, loading placeholder (~1 PR)
5. **P0** — agent timeout + flow cancel (agent YAML + e2e, ~1–2 PRs)
6. **P5, P6, P7** — as metadata/reliability requirements firm up

---

## Explicitly out of scope

- Finance demo flows (transfers, cards, help, goodbye, etc.)
- Embedded mode (`isEmbedded`, onboarding tooltips, chat-header inspect toggle)
- Conversation replay (not a supported feature)
- Full finance agent regression
